runtime.execution: Synchronous conversation loop, daemon tool/child pools, per-owner Python session kernels and gateway background routing.
runtime.service_boundary: Consumes model/SSH/container/MCP services; owns local kernels, process registry, SQLite transcript and plugin tasks. This local ownership differs from Arconaut shared-service consumption.

summary: Strong non-destructive transcript compaction, programmable context-engine selection, live child steering and real persistent Python; abandoning tool threads is not resource settlement.

inspection.scope: Traced actual turn facade/loop context hooks, commit-before-project tools, kernel namespace/destruction, remote fallback, delegation credentials/control, background process routing, SQLite compaction and curator fork.
inspection.limits: Source study only; no acquired code executed. Not every gateway, provider, approval rule or community plugin traced; no universal absence claims.

actions.name: execute_code / reset
actions.output: output/status/kernel execution count and tool results
actions.lifecycle: persistent owner namespace; timeout/interrupt destroys it; remote spawn failure changes to per-call mode
actions.authority: model execution guard and configured project/strict/backend scope

actions.name: terminal background / process routing
actions.output: tracked session handle, output and completion routing
actions.lifecycle: background survives turn when permitted; finite hosts require polling
actions.authority: owner/task registry; local or remote environment

actions.name: delegate_task spawn/list/steer/stop
actions.output: child handles/results, queued steering or interrupt_requested
actions.lifecycle: sync/parallel/background paths; child timeout can leave worker closing later
actions.authority: only own spawn tree; bound session/transport checks

actions.name: ContextEngine.select_context / on_turn_complete
actions.input: request/history clones, token budget, turn metadata
actions.lifecycle: per turn, invalid/exception selection keeps original request
actions.authority: native extension engine access; persisted history clone prevents write-through

actions.name: session_search discover/read/scroll/browse
actions.lifecycle: standing SQLite history reads; scope differs from raw provider audit
actions.authority: model registered tool using registry-acquired DB

actions.name: archive_and_compact
actions.output: new active projection and retained old rows
actions.lifecycle: atomic publication preserves arrivals, rejects stale lease
actions.authority: host compaction service and DB API

actions.name: Curator review fork
actions.input: configured skills candidates and review prompt
actions.output: skill mutations, report and scheduler metadata
actions.lifecycle: background model fork; ledgered skill surface only
actions.authority: curator excludes terminal; no independent benefit evaluation proved

filesystem.detail: Native code and terminal access plus spill files; dedicated file surfaces not exhaustively traced.

processes.detail: Owner-tracked local/remote process spawn and completion delivery; exact full process-tool control dispatch not studied.

code_actions.detail: Persistent Python code calls ordinary registered tools through RPC; native context-engine programs.

persistent_kernel.detail: Actual GLOBALS persist across cells, exception retains namespace; timeout/interrupt explicitly destroys state. Remote failures can degrade to per-call execution.

standing_database.detail: SQLite persisted/searchable transcript with shared handle borrowing, not general model SQL research DB.

workflow_programming.detail: Context engine controls request selection, plugin message injection and child/program orchestration; arbitrary whole-turn replacement not established.

multi_model.detail: Per-child model/provider/endpoint credentials resolve distinct from parent.

live_collaboration.detail: Model can steer live owned children at iteration boundary, but no unrestricted peer-room path established in this scope.

concurrent_work.detail: Concurrent tool pools, child futures and background process routing.

steering_interrupt.detail: Steering queues with missed-delivery accounting; cancellation may abandon still-active tool worker or defer child close. Kernel timeout kills namespace.

turn_redefinition.detail: Custom context engine changes per-request context and completion program; broad native plugins, not proven hot replacement of complete turn semantics.

compaction.detail: Atomic non-destructive projection with coverage/watermark, lease fencing and concurrent-tail cloning.

context_repair.detail: Retained inactive/compacted originals and model search/read support repair; automatic arbitrary corrupted-context repair operation not established.

original_audit.detail: Commit-before-project helps transcript durability; transformed/redacted/bounded outputs, capped best-effort spill and truncated curator arguments are not all original IO.

audit_query.detail: Actual model message search/read/scroll; raw provider requests/transport/effect streams not established as captured/queryable.

hot_change.detail: Plugins own registration cleanup and live injection, code config read per execution; precise all reload settling/staging paths not fully traced.

rebuild_continuity.detail: DB transcript/leases support reattach and component changes, but abandoned tool workers/local-owned kernels do not establish quiescent executable refit/outpost handoff.

remote_services.detail: Configured remote execution consumer with persistent remote kernel/fallback and independent child model endpoint.

self_improvement.detail: Model curator can consolidate/modify skills through constrained ledgered tools; independent experiment/heldout performance promotion not established.

complaints.detail: Not established beyond inspected turn, kernel, transcript, plugin and delegation paths.

authority.detail: Code execution approved/blocked at guard, project/strict backends; model child control scoped to own tree. Complete bypass/default approval policy outside inspection.

evaluation.detail: Read namespace literal tests, real host-death subprocess oracle and exact compaction concurrent-tail/archive oracles; not executed here.

time_order.detail: Monotonic execution deadline/duration distinct from wall-clock DB lease expiry; ordered durable arrivals and explicit inactivity child waits.

evidence.claim: Scoped run, finalization and lease refresh thread joins; turn completion does not join all abandoned tool workers.
Sequential interrupt gives3s grace then cancelled result, cancels future and shuts executor without waiting on abandoned worker.
Concurrent tools deadline/interrupt abandon daemon worker pool rather than await all active effects.
Tool-result spill/transformation append and DB flush precede completed projection.
Actual optional context-engine selection and completion hooks with copied history and fail-open fallback.
Cell exec uses GLOBALS, capturing output/errors; variables persist across requests.
Timeout/interrupt discard kernel/state, redacted bounded results and spill references; sys.exit explicitly ends kernel.
Kernel teardown signals process tree and removes resources.
TERM tree wait5s then KILL, without second confirmed-death wait in this helper.
Remote persistent kernel first, failures fall open to per-call script execution.
Code guard then local persistent session kernel or remote path; max call/time limits.
Inline byte truncation and best-effort digest spill capped5million characters; not complete original-output audit.
Tracked local/env process spawn with owner and gateway completion routing; finite hosts report lack of async delivery.
Child model/provider/endpoint override actually resolved, not simply inherited adapter.
Thread-backed child run with liveness-aware wait.
Timeout result includes phase/API count/last-event age; still-running worker closes later via callback.
Live child steering queues without cutting tool; missed boundary explicitly reported, ownership checked.
Model list/steer/stop own spawn tree; stop response says interrupt_requested, not terminated.
Model session query dispatch borrows and releases shared SessionDB handles.
Search/read/scroll/browse actual DB messages, not generated summary; schema contract.
Compaction retains soft-archived originals, lease-fenced publish and concurrent arrival watermark.
Actual transaction archives old rows, inserts summary and clones concurrent tail; no deletion.
Owned registration cleanup and plugin-triggered live gateway message injector; remaining global slot profile keying TODO.
Actual model fork modifies skills through ledgered surface; metadata tool args truncated, no independent usefulness gate.
Literal cross-cell value/reset/exception namespace tests.
Real subprocess host kill then kernel.wait oracle, not just registry absence.
Exact summary+arrival order and sidecars; originals retained inactive.

tests.oracle: Literal retained values and reset/exception behavior; separate real process wait after host death; not run.
Exact ordered contents/sidecars and inactive original rows, stale lease refusal; not run.

strengths: Non-destructive compaction preserves original rows and concurrent arrivals.
Persistent Python kernel is actual cross-cell namespace, with explicit destructive timeout.
Child stop response explicitly distinguishes request from completion.
limits: Daemon worker abandonment lets a turn complete with unconfirmed effects.
Host-owned kernels/processes differ from shared standing-service consumption.
Selective transcript/result persistence is not original IO audit.
arconaut_questions: Use compaction coverage/watermark and retained originals to model repair datasets.
Do not infer quiescence from completed turn or cancelled future.
Make persistent-to-per-call execution degradation explicit to model/operator.
